title: drive.budget_usd charges a redo for the abandoned attempt's spend, so a re-started feature escalates budget_exceeded before doing any work
detail: usage.measure(feature) sums every effort.phase_windows window for the feature name, across sprint_abandoned boundaries. Observed 2026-11-18: observed-writes was abandoned 2026-11-16 at ~$30; the redo's first drive check escalated budget_exceeded in scoping at $31.34 vs the $19 cap (building $21.93 was all the old attempt). Expected: the sprint cap (drive.budget_usd) counts windows since the feature's latest sprint_started; prior attempts are reported beside it, not charged to it. sprint-abandon is operator-gated and ledgered, so the reset is visible, not a dodge.
